about: Renovating an apartment in TRIIINITY: compact and large formats

The 53–125 m² range means two different scenarios. In a 53–60 m² apartment the key is to fit a full kitchen-living room, a wardrobe and a comfortable bathroom without feeling cramped: built-in floor-to-ceiling furniture, hidden doors and well-planned lighting help. Apartments of 100+ m² have room for a master bedroom with its own bathroom, a study and a separate laundry.

The premium segment implies engineering you only notice as comfort: quiet air conditioning with concealed units, underfloor heating in the bathrooms, smart lighting control. We build these systems in at the design stage so finished walls never have to be cut.

A building of this level usually has management-company renovation rules covering working hours, protection of common areas and removal of construction waste. We include them in the schedule from day one.
For reference: developer — Seven Hills, address — 39/2 Vasylia Tiutiunnyka St. We do not represent the developer or the management company — we work directly with the apartment owner.

faq: How much does an apartment renovation in TRIIINITY cost?

Turnkey renovation starts from $550/m² (works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are extra, per the estimate), a design project from $30/m² (minimum $2,500), furnishing from $250/m². The calculation for a 90 m² apartment is in the budget guide above; we fix the exact amount in the estimate after the inspection.
How can a small apartment feel premium?

Through the layout and the details: built-in floor-to-ceiling wardrobes, hidden doors, quality lighting and a restrained palette of materials. We set this in the design project before the renovation starts.
Can the air conditioners and ventilation be hidden?
Yes, if it is planned in the project: ducted or cassette systems, access hatches, suspended ceilings. We align the solution with the building's requirements for the façade and utility networks.
We hand over the apartment with a signed acceptance certificate; all completed works carry a 12-month warranty.
Can I follow the renovation remotely?
Yes. We send photo reports from the site via Telegram, and the price, timeline and payment stages are fixed in the contract.
